objects.content: 参与者：SEEKER、RECOMMENDER；刺激动作：SEEKER 对 RECOMMENDER 连续说出以下话语：'Hello, could you please recommend a good comedy movie?...It can also have action in it'；'I have, it is pretty funny....What other suggestions do you have'；'I didnt liked that one'；对象：RECOMMENDER；场景：电影推荐对话；刺激侧变化：SEEKER 发出推荐喜剧电影的请求；SEEKER 说 'I have, it is pretty funny'；SEEKER 询问 'What other suggestions do you have'；SEEKER 说 'I didnt liked that one'；约束变化：SEEKER 要求推荐的是 comedy movie，并且 it can also have action in it；我执侧重：RECOMMENDER 把「自己作为推荐者所给出的建议」当成与我分不开；SEEKER 说「I didnt liked that one」指向先前的推荐，使这条黏着被点燃。；法执侧重：RECOMMENDER 把 SEEKER 提出的「comedy movie，且 can also have action」执成推荐只能在此类型组合内进行的固定条件。

observed_action: RECOMMENDER 问候并询问对方今天想找哪种电影；RECOMMENDER 说自己前几天刚看了 The Other Guys (2010)，问对方是否看过，并说它挺好笑；RECOMMENDER 问 Tropic Thunder (2008) 怎么样。
